name: ai-bench
description: Anatolii's agentic-AI workbench: subagents, skills and tool configs, including skills vendored from other repos with a pinned commit.

interface.shortDescription: Work entrypoint, model setup, review, and writing
interface.longDescription: Start or resume evidence-backed work through a generic main entrypoint, configure per-role model overrides for Claude Code and Codex pstack-derived skills, review code structure and maintainability, and edit drafts to remove formulaic AI wording. Task intake can use checkout-specific tracker instructions from .local/tracker.md.
defaultPrompt: Use task-intake to check this ticket and choose its playbook.
Use main to start or resume this work through its selected playbook.
Use setup-pstack to configure model overrides for this harness.
Use thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review to review this branch's changes.
Use unslop to edit this draft.
